questions.question: Mock (leadership): product tezligi va SRE error budget freeze'i o'rtasidagi konfliktni qanday hal qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Error budget policy — rahbariyat imzolagan kelishuv ekanini eslatish (siyosat, shaxsiy fikr emas).

questions.question: Mock (leadership): blameless post-mortem madaniyatini qanday o'rnatasiz?
questions.explanation: Inson xatosi tekshiruvning boshlanishi, xulosasi emas — buni rahbar o'z misolida ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): cross-functional chaos engineering GameDay'ni qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Gipoteza: "Payment pod'larga 50% paket yo'qotish kiritilsa, circuit breaker ishlaydi va checkout muvaffaqiyati > 99.9% qoladi".

questions.question: Mock (leadership): SRE jamoasida on-call burnout va alert fatigue'ni qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Alert auditi: shovqinli, harakat talab qilmaydigan threshold alert'larni o'chirish.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): 20 ta jamoa bo'ylab cloud xarajatini kamaytirishni qanday olib borasiz?
questions.explanation: Majburiy tag'lar (Owner, Environment, CostCenter) — SCP/policy bilan majburlanadi; showback/chargeback.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): on-call handoff va rotatsiya jarayonini qanday loyihalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Har hafta chiqib ketayotgan va kirayotgan on-call orasida 30 daqiqalik handoff.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): SEV1 avariya paytida stakeholder kommunikatsiyasini qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Incident bridge'ga alohida Communications Lead tayinlash — texnik javobgarlar diagnozga e'tibor beradi.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): butun tashkilotni Internal Developer Platform'ga qanday o'tkazasiz?
questions.explanation: Platformani mahsulot sifatida ko'rish: jamoalardan kundalik og'riqlarni intervyu qilish.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): junior DevOps'larni kuchli SRE'larga qanday tarbiyalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Shadow on-call: junior avval incident'larni kuzatadi, keyin reverse-shadow, keyin primary.

questions.question: Mock (leadership): infra investitsiyasi va texnik qarzni rahbariyatga qanday asoslaysiz?
questions.explanation: Texnik qarzni biznes xavfi tiliga tarjima qilish: downtime soati uchun yo'qotilgan daromad, churn, dasturchi kutish vaqti narxi, compliance va xavfsizlik ta'siri — investitsiya va kutilgan qaytimni raqamlar bilan.
